The '''Brachi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brachi]].
